## What changed

Describe the user-visible result and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run theme:check`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `docker compose build`
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or recording made with synthetic material

## Compatibility

- [ ] No `.lyricstapper.json` or legacy `.beatmark.json` behavior changed
- [ ] Any project-format change includes compatibility tests and documentation

Do not attach private songs, lyrics, project files, local paths, or personal metadata.
